newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable, trade inactive.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable, trade inactive.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were unchanged in the late session as a national holiday in Tokyo kept the market inactive, dealers said.
They said SIR20 was on offer at 56.00-56.50 cents/lb fob Medan, 55.75 cents fob Palembang, 55.38 cents fob Jambi and 55.50 cents fob Pontianak for December shipments.

"The market was rather quiet because of the holiday in Tokyo," one Medan dealer said. "Last week 300-400 tonnes of SIR20 was sold to a South Korean tyremaker at 55.75 cents/lb fob Medan for December shipment. I think the buyer is in the market for more offtakes and am expecting him this week."
Another dealer said December shipment RSS1 was done at 126 cents/kg fob Semarang, up from last done 125.50 cents.
"I sold about 100 tonnes late last week," he added. "So far today, the market has been quiet."
High amoniac grade latex, with 60 percent dry rubber content, was last traded at 2,200-2,300 rupiah/kg for December deliveries against the previous 2,230 rupiah, dealers said.
